_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Facilities Requirements Document (FRD)
summary: The Facilities Requirements Document identifies and describes all facilities requirements for maintenance, support equipment, space, utilities, and environment necessary to support the system.
use_relationship:
The Facilities Requirements Document identifies and describes all facilities requirements for maintenance, support equipment, space, utilities, and environment necessary to support the system.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Facilities Requirements Document (FRD) format shall be contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The FRD shall contain a title page specifying the following:

children.title: Summary
children.content: The FRD shall contain a summary which includes a brief statement of the overall project status; objectives of the document; summary results; identification of major problems/deficiencies with impact; and recommendations.

children.title: Requirements and recommendations
children.content: The FRD shall identify requirements and recommendations (if applicable) for the following:

children.title: Brief description of functions to be performed and equipment and personnel to be accommodated.
Individual Element Space and weight requirements
Environment Requirements such as hazardous materials
Any other special facilities requirements (Scope of Certification, etc.)
Appendices.
children.content: The FRD Appendices shall be included where applicable, for tables, references, charts, or other descriptive material. Each appendix shall be identified and referenced in the appropriate text of the document.
